verified_facts.text: The resort sits on 13 acres of private bayfront on the island of Key Largo in the Florida Keys.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on 13 acres of private bayfront, the resort is located on the island of Key Largo in the Florida Keys.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two waterfall pools and beach hammocks.

verified_facts.text: Water activities offered include diving, parasailing, catamaran sailing and deep-sea fishing.

verified_facts.text: There are two beaches: Hammock Beach, which tends to be quiet, and a more active beach for watersports such as kayaking and paddleboarding.
